summary: Build and manage your industrial car factory simulator. Upgrade and make money!
description:
Build your own business empire from the ground up and become a millionaire in this Idle clicker! 🔧🚀
Automate your factory, tap to earn, and grow your simulation business - even while you're offline! 😴💰

In Idle Inventor, you're the mastermind behind the factory tycoon in charge of building powerful machines - from simple cars to futuristic spacecraft. It’s one of the most satisfying idle games for fans of simulation, clicker and money-making games.

🧭 Turn every build into an adventure as you explore new factory types and discover exciting production combos.
👔 Hire the perfect managers and watch your production lines run like clockwork - no micromanagement needed!
💸 Start as a small manager and grow into the boss money legend of the idle world!

🏭 5 Unique Factories, 60 Vehicles to Build!
Each factory simulator unlocks a new category of vehicles:
🚙 12 sleek cars (car tycoon!)
✈ 12 flying machines
🚚 12 construction vehicles
🚁 12 military machines
🚀 12 space exploration vehicles

Every vehicle built brings more profit. Tap, merge, and manage to keep the money flowing and cargo ships full!

🔬 Feeling creative? Just like in Little Alchemy, combine resources and machines to invent entirely new vehicles - your own industrial adventure awaits!

💼 Idle Tycoon Life, Made Simple
Your role as a factory manager is to:
✅ Automate production for offline earnings
✅ Unlock & upgrade production lines
✅ Boost your business simulator profits
✅ Hire over 200 unique managers
✅ Tap smart, earn fast

With every upgrade, your tiny workshop becomes a powerful business empire simulator. This is what idle building games are all about.The game never stops - and neither do the profits. 💸

⏰ Auto Clicker Simulation
Don’t worry if you log off - your factory keeps working! This is the magic of idle games!
Just tap to collect profits when you’re back. It’s the ultimate auto clicker simulator for busy players.

🧠 Deep Strategy Meets Chill Gameplay
Where should you invest next?
Will you hire a better manager, build a new line, or boost your most profitable machine?
This idle game lets you play your way – no stress, no timers, just satisfying decisions.

🏆 Key Features:
- Engaging idle tycoon gameplay
- 5 unique factories with a growing car empire
- 200 collectible managers
- Dozens of upgrades per factory
- Perfect idle simulator: earn while away
- Great for fans of clicker games, factory simulators, and money tycoons
- Gorgeous low-poly visuals
- Offline profits & limited-time events

🤑 Tip: Always Watch for Special Offers
Sometimes a deal pops up that gives you research points, cash boosts, or rare managers - grab it fast!

Are you ready to become the next industrial magnate?
Start building your Idle Inventor legacy today and see how big your empire can grow! 👑
